title: Stop YouTube previews on hover
question: How do I stop YouTube videos from playing when I hover over them?
answer: Signed out, YouTube has no switch to stop videos playing when you hover over a thumbnail. The usermods script on this page stops the hover preview everywhere: it hides the preview that YouTube lays over a thumbnail and pauses its video, so the plain thumbnail stays and no preview keeps playing out of sight. Clicking a video still opens it as usual, and the watch page player is untouched.
prompt: Stop YouTube from playing previews when I hover over a video thumbnail.
details: YouTube plays hover previews in a floating element, `#video-preview`, placed over the thumbnail. The script hides that element with CSS and pauses any video that starts playing inside it. The check hovers a thumbnail on a search results page. The home page and channel pages use the same preview element, but the check does not load them.

alternatives.title: uBlock Origin filter

PointerEvent : MouseEvent)(t, { bubbles: !t.endsWith('enter'), composed: true, clientX: r.x + 20, clientY: r.y + 20, view: window })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 4000));
check.baseline: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#video-preview'); const v = p && p.querySelector('video'); return !!p && p.checkVisibility() && !!v && !v.paused; })()
check.expect: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#video-preview'); const v = p && p.querySelector('video'); return !!p && !p.checkVisibility() && (!v || v.paused); })()
